selection_protocol.league_definition: Each league contains one manager per selected strategy and gives every manager the same opening 15-player squad.
selection_protocol.rank_definition: 1 + the number of managers with strictly more net points; tied leaders share rank 1.
selection_protocol.strategy_selection: Best hybrid is selected on development win rate, then mean rank, then rank standard deviation, then mean net points.
selection_protocol.holdout_is_used_for: one-time benchmark after strategy profiles and selection rules are frozen

assumptions: This is a synthetic strategy league, not a reconstruction of an actual mini-league.
The same opening squad is used by all managers within a season/scenario so the comparison isolates transfer policy.
The safe and balanced hybrids take at most one transfer per gameweek and never pay a hit; hybrid_win can use one paid transfer when its action model clears a higher gate.
Standings influence only the hybrid objective near the margin through deficit and ownership leverage; they do not replace points, price, fixture, minutes, news, or legality checks.
Chips, bench-boost decisions, and real manager-entry histories remain outside this first league model.
